extDescription.message: Firefox-style Picture-in-Picture for Chrome: hover toggle, full playback controls, captions, shortcuts, and auto-PiP.

placeholderText.message: This video is playing in Picture-in-Picture

optionsIntro.message: These options match Firefox Picture-in-Picture, including the extra controls in the player window.

toggleEnabled.message: Show the Picture-in-Picture toggle on videos

alwaysShowToggle.message: Always show the toggle (ignore the 45-second and size checks)

minVideoSecs.message: Minimum video length for the toggle (seconds)

autoPip.message: Automatically open Picture-in-Picture when switching tabs

keyboardControls.message: Enable keyboard controls in the Picture-in-Picture window

captionsEnabled.message: Show captions and subtitles in Picture-in-Picture

pauseOnClose.message: Pause the video when the Picture-in-Picture window is closed

showPlaceholder.message: Show a placeholder on the original video while Picture-in-Picture is open

shortcutToggle.message: Ctrl+Shift+] (macOS: ⌘⇧⌥]) opens or closes Picture-in-Picture for the most relevant video. Chrome also assigns Ctrl+Shift+9, which you can change at chrome://extensions/shortcuts.

shortcutPlayer.message: In the player: Space play/pause, ←/→ seek 5 seconds, Ctrl+←/→ seek 10%, ↑/↓ volume, Ctrl+↑/↓ unmute/mute, Home/End, F fullscreen, Ctrl+W close, Shift+Esc or Shift+click close without pausing.
